data.name: Dhakir
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'dh-k-r', which means 'to remember' or 'to commemorate'. In Islamic tradition, Dhakir refers to the one who remembers and keeps the remembrance of Allah (swt) in their heart, mind, and actions.

in_english.name: Dhakir
in_english.long_meaning: Dhakir is an Arabic name that means 'one who remembers Allah' or 'one who is mindful of God'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'ذ-ك-ر' which means 'to remember' or 'to mention'. The name Dhakir has been mentioned in the Quran, such as in the verse {And the men who remember Allah much}. It signifies a person who frequently remembers and acknowledges God's presence in their life.
